propositions: Duplicate tickets with identical titles are filed and discovered only mid-implementation because create-time detection is absent by design (ADR 0086 placed detection at review time, off the write path).
A bounded O(window) same-normalized-title probe using a 600 s rolling recent-creates.json sidecar journal can detect and warn about duplicates at creation time without blocking writes.
The probe must serialize concurrent creates under fcntl.flock to ensure a later create observes an earlier one's entry and both are recorded without clobbering.
The advisory warning surfaces the candidate ticket's id, status, and age on all channels (CLI stderr, library dict, MCP result field) while keeping creation non-blocking (exit 0).
Gating on the existing verify.suggest_duplicate_tickets config key ensures zero write-path footprint when disabled and graceful degradation on probe failures (corrupt journal or config error).
